payout_quote: When they open their new account, both you and your friend will receive $25 as a thank you. The best part? No Limits! Refer as many friends as you like and keep earning rewards.
steps: Be a Members First Credit Union member
Refer a friend who has never been a member; submit the Refer a Friend form
Friend opens a new account (checking with Visa Check Card per the referral coupon)
Both you and your friend receive $25
catches: Friend must never have been a member before and be approved to open an account
Referral coupon/form must be submitted; friend presents the coupon at account opening
New member may need to make 5 Visa check-card credit transactions for the payout (per aggregator summary of the coupon)
No limits stated — refer as many as you like
biggest_catch: Your friend has to be brand new to Members First CU — never a member before — and the referral form has to be filed at account opening.
eligibility: Members First CU members; friends never previously members, approved for an account
timing: Timing not stated on the program page
